quote: It is unlawful for any person to drive or operate a vehicle of any kind or character at: A rate of speed greater than that posted by a public authority for the particular portion of highway being traversed.

activation.condition: a public authority has posted a speed limit for the portion of highway; the subject drives on that portion

obligation.description: It is unlawful for any person to drive or operate a vehicle of any kind or character at: A rate of speed greater than that posted by a public authority for the particular portion of highway being traversed.

description.requirement: the limit binds at every instant on the posted portion
the violation is any instant above the posted value, subject to a declared measurement tolerance
